mapper.select: /* common.mdsr.selectMasterMdSrSrProcWritePop */ SELECT A.SR_NO AS SR_NO, DECODE ( A.RECV_FLAG, 'GP', DECODE (#{st_user_id}, A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID, '결재대상', '결재중'), 'GB', '결재반려', 'GA', '요청', 'GS', '요청취소', 'DS', '접수', 'PS', '처리중', 'PA', '처리완료', 'PB', '보류처리', 'GG', '완료') AS RECV_TEXT, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR01' AND CODE = A.SYS_TYPE) AS SYS_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR02' AND CODE = A.REQ_TYPE) || (SELECT ' / ' || TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR05' AND CODE = A.REQ_SR_TYPE) AS REQ_TEXT, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_TIME, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PH_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS PH_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.FF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS FF_DATE, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DF_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DF_TIME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID) AS REQ_CONFIRM_NAME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID) AS DS_USER_NAME, A.REQ_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK, A.REQ_ATTKEY, A.DF_REMARK, A.FF_ATTKEY, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID AS REQ_CONFIRM_ID, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_CONFIRM_TIME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = A.REQ_DEPT) REQ_DEPT_NAME, A.SR_SUBJECT, (SELECT MAX(TARGET) FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND DOC_NAME = 'SR' AND KEY_1 = A.SR_NO) AS DOCU_NO FROM KEPASRDT A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{st_sr_user_id} AND A.SR_NO = #{st_sr_no}
